properties.name: Greater Bangkok fringe - Rangsit / Thanyaburi, Pathum Thani
properties.name_th: รังสิต / ธัญบุรี จังหวัดปทุมธานี
properties.event_name: Lower Chao Phraya seasonal flooding, 2024 and 2025
properties.adm3_covered: Rangsit, Thanyaburi and Lam Luk Ka subdistricts
properties.derivation: Newly proposed for this request. Not yet present in committed FloodGuard evidence. Represents the dense Greater Bangkok fringe named as the scale target in the project brief.
properties.purpose: Urban-density stress tile. High building and road density is the hardest case for the road-disruption and access-loss models. Carries the single clearest flood-season observation measured in this scout.

requested_windows.label: Flood event window 2024
requested_windows.revision: narrowed and cloud limit lowered from 80%
requested_windows.note: The best flood-period optical opportunity in this request. Clear imagery during the flood season demonstrably exists here, which is not true for Mae Sai or Hat Yai.

requested_windows.label: Flood event window 2025
requested_windows.revision: narrowed, cloud limit lowered, priority reduced
requested_windows.measured_evidence: 2025 was markedly cloudier. AOI-06 best 2025-11-16 at 3.4% and 2025-10-22 at 17.5%; AOI-05 best in-window only 42.7%.
requested_windows.note: Second seasonal repeat, useful as an independent event fold, but clearly lower value than the 2024 window.

requested_windows.label: Dry-season clear baseline
requested_windows.note: Central plain dry season; clear acquisitions are near certain.

properties.cloud_metric: max_cloud_pct is the AOI-clipped Sentinel-2 SCL measurement from scripts/scout_theos2_aoi_cloud.py and is what determines whether an acquisition is usable. portal_scene_cloud_filter_pct is the scene-level value to enter in the GISTDA ordering portal, which filters over the whole satellite footprint rather than the AOI; entering the AOI value there would discard usable dates. See outputs/theos2_aoi_cloud_scout.csv and outputs/theos2_portal_cloud_thresholds.csv.
properties.redistribution_intent: None. Imagery stays in a controlled workspace outside version control. Only derived, checksum-tracked evidence is committed.
